== Players Committee forum (forum.starwarsccg.org) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New page from posts on the Players Committee forum. Topics used: 21590, 22883.
The cited posts are live forum.starwarsccg.org posts; they have no Internet Archive capture yet (forum snapshots are to be added later), so the refs carry no Preserved copy for now.
=== Identification ===
* The Advocate account that announced the event is Scott Lingrell's renamed CRingwell account (players address it as "Scott"; quotes of its posts elsewhere show "CRingwell wrote").
* Lingrell's player list (p318279) gives surnames or handles only. Pinto, Gagliardi, Bordier, Borata, El Mundo and Gogolen are left as posted; probable matches on the wiki are [[Joe Pinto]], [[Joseph Gagliardi]] (also "Joey G."?) and [[Chris Gogolen]] (who asked in the topic who was going, p317492). Bordier could be Ray or Roy Bordier.
=== Missing data ===
* Full results: Kafer promised "full results later" (p318333); none were posted in the topic.
